pairs.evidence: src/features/teams/sub_factory/l2/useFactoryScans.ts:82 the Factory L2 'Scan for KPIs' and (:105) context re-scan buttons spawn a headless claude with cwd = the attached project root (src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/kpi_scan.rs:807, src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/context_generation.rs:1629) through build_cli_args, which emits --dangerously-skip-permissions with no --setting-sources restriction (src-tauri/engine/src/prompt/cli_args.rs:107), so the scanned repo's CLAUDE.md and .claude/settings.json hooks run under a read verb with no digest approval

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/engine/src/cli_process.rs:467 every headless one-shot (KPI scan, context scan) takes build_cli_args' --dangerously-skip-permissions and reads the target tree's own settings/hooks; no approved-digest gate, no loud refusal on change, not default-off
src/features/teams/sub_factory/l2/factoryL2Data.ts:1 the context is a per-project data layer and scan launcher; it downloads and unpacks no archive
src/features/teams/sub_factory/l2/factoryL2Data.ts:1 no lockfile, manifest or resolved dependency graph crosses this context; the repo-level gates are judged elsewhere
src/features/teams/sub_factory/l2/factoryL2Data.ts:1 the context declares no capability, CSP or permission manifest

pairs.registryProposal: This is the fourth context in this repo (after plugins-dev-tools-context, plugins-dev-tools-projects and prompt-assembly-engine) where one root cause, a shared CLI-args builder with --dangerously-skip-permissions, produces the reading-is-not-running deviation once per UI surface that reaches it. The technique could add a decision rule: when the evaluating spawn is one shared builder, judge and fix it at the builder and record the per-surface hits as reach rather than as separate defects.
